title: Messy paint job
text:
Messy paint job. Being from the east coast, milk jugs are used pretty often for decor. A black one seemed like a good addition to our home style but this one fell a little short of what I was expecting.

It is quite small, which isn’t a bad thing but it was smaller than I expected. It is also originally white or tan underneath the haphazardly applied black paint. There are a lot of dents and imperfections in it that do not look intentional. Finally there was a dead spider in ours when it arrived. It might be fine on a shelf where no one will look at it up close.
